### 1. CODEOWNERS / Ownership Rules

**Repository-wide.** CODEOWNERS is at [`.github/CODEOWNERS`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/azure-azure-sdk-for-python@7e1331b1677a50c42a7a2fc2c5c489a1fdc72f5b/-/blob/.github/CODEOWNERS).

Observations:

- Every SDK service directory has an **explicit, per-path ownership entry**. Examples: `/sdk/core/azure-core/` (line 23), `/sdk/ai/azure-ai-agents/` (line 45), `/sdk/cosmos/` (line 193).
- Comments above each block carry structured metadata read by automation: `# PRLabel: %...`, `# ServiceLabel: %...`, `# AzureSdkOwners: @...`, `# ServiceOwners: @...`. These are not freeform comments — they drive label assignment and routing in the event-processing pipeline.

**Deterministic verification query:** `keyword_search "AzureSdkOwners" repo:^github.com/sg-evals/azure-azure-sdk-for-python$ file:.github/CODEOWNERS` to enumerate all named SDK owners.

### 2. Pull Request Template (Human Checklist)

**Repository-wide.** File: [`.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/azure-azure-sdk-for-python@7e1331b1677a50c42a7a2fc2c5c489a1fdc72f5b/-/blob/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md).

Checklist items that every PR author must attest to:
- No breaking changes introduced.
- CHANGELOG updated for new features/bug fixes.
- Contribution guidelines read.
- PR title is clear and informative.
- Commits are clean (no previously-merged commits in history).
- **Test coverage included for changes** (line 17).

The template also requires a link to the upstream Swagger/API spec PR if the SDK was regenerated.

---

### 3. CI Entry Points

#### 3a. Azure DevOps PR Pipeline (`pullrequest.yml`)

**Repository-wide.** File: [`eng/pipelines/pullrequest.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/azure-azure-sdk-for-python@7e1331b1677a50c42a7a2fc2c5c489a1fdc72f5b/-/blob/eng/pipelines/pullrequest.yml).

- Triggers on PRs targeting `main`, `feature/*`, `hotfix/*`, `release/*`, `restapi*`, `pipelinev3*`.
- Path includes `"*"` (everything), with a single exclusion: `.github/skills/azsdk-common-*/**`.
- Delegates to [`archetype-sdk-client.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/azure-azure-sdk-for-python@7e1331b1677a50c42a7a2fc2c5c489a1fdc72f5b/-/blob/eng/pipelines/templates/stages/archetype-sdk-client.yml).
- `TestProxy: true` (all tests run through the test proxy by default in PRs).

**Repository-wide template; instantiated per service.** File: [`ci_template.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/azure-azure-sdk-for-python@7e1331b1677a50c42a7a2fc2c5c489a1fdc72f5b/-/blob/ci_template.yml).

### 9. Test Infrastructure

- **Framework**: pytest (stated in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/azure-azure-sdk-for-python@7e1331b1677a50c42a7a2fc2c5c489a1fdc72f5b/-/blob/CONTRIBUTING.md?L18) line 18).

- **Cosmos exclusion**: explicitly carved out of the PR pipeline because the cosmos emulator cannot be injected into the standard PR job.

### 10. Local Reproducibility Guarantee

The `azpysdk` CLI (from `eng/tools/azure-sdk-tools`) is the same entrypoint used in CI — all CI steps call `dispatch_checks.py` with a `--checks=<name>` flag that maps directly to the same `azpysdk <check>` subcommands documented in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/azure-azure-sdk-for-python@7e1331b1677a50c42a7a2fc2c5c489a1fdc72f5b/-/blob/CONTRIBUTING.md?L48-L65) lines 48-65. ### 7. Generated Code Controls

- **Autorest pipeline**: [`eng/pipelines/autorest_checks.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/azure-azure-sdk-for-python@7e1331b1677a50c42a7a2fc2c5c489a1fdc72f5b/-/blob/eng/pipelines/autorest_checks.yml) triggers on PRs touching `sdk/core/` only; clones `autorest.python`, installs `azure-core`/`azure-mgmt-core`, and runs vanilla + Azure legacy test suites with pytest.
- **CONTRIBUTING.md** (line 8) explicitly states PRs touching autorest-generated files (header: `Code generated by Microsoft (R) AutoRest Code Generator`) **cannot be merged** — contributors must open a PR on the upstream Swagger spec instead.
- **TypeSpec regeneration**: [`typespec-python-regenerate.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/azure-azure-sdk-for-python@7e1331b1677a50c42a7a2fc2c5c489a1fdc72f5b/-/blob/.github/workflows/typespec-python-regenerate.yml) runs daily at 22:00 UTC and on push to `eng/emitter-package.json`. It accepts a `typespec_ref` input pointing to either `microsoft/typespec@main` or a specific PR URL, resolves the head SHA, and can open follow-up PRs.
- **ci_template.yml** bears a `# DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE / generated automatically` header; per-service `ci.yml` files are generated from it.

### 9. Test Infrastructure

- **Framework**: pytest (stated in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/azure-azure-sdk-for-python@7e1331b1677a50c42a7a2fc2c5c489a1fdc72f5b/-/blob/CONTRIBUTING.md?L18) line 18).
- **Test proxy**: enabled by default in PR pipeline (`TestProxy: true`); injected into `build-test.yml`.
- **Matrix**: `platform-matrix.json` drives sparse OS/version combinations via the `generate-job-matrix.yml` common template. Configurations labeled `Python_ci_test_base` with `Selection: sparse`.
- **PR batching**: when `ServiceDirectory: auto`, matrix generation is enabled with `PRJobBatchSize: 5` and `PRMatrixSetting: TargetingString`.
- **Separate job templates**: `ci.tests.yml` (unit/integration), `live.tests.yml`, `perf.yml`, `regression.yml`, `smoke.tests.yml` — all present under [`eng/pipelines/templates/jobs/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/azure-azure-sdk-for-python@7e1331b1677a50c42a7a2fc2c5c489a1fdc72f5b/-/tree/eng/pipelines/templates/jobs).
- **Cosmos exclusion**: explicitly carved out of the PR pipeline because the cosmos emulator cannot be injected into the standard PR job.

---

### 10. Local Reproducibility Guarantee

The `azpysdk` CLI (from `eng/tools/azure-sdk-tools`) is the same entrypoint used in CI — all CI steps call `dispatch_checks.py` with a `--checks=<name>` flag that maps directly to the same `azpysdk <check>` subcommands documented in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/azure-azure-sdk-for-python@7e1331b1677a50c42a7a2fc2c5c489a1fdc72f5b/-/blob/CONTRIBUTING.md?L48-L65) lines 48-65. The `--isolate` flag runs each check in a fresh virtual environment.
